source_observations.finding: VoiceOutputPacket.sha256() includes voiceoutcome_ref. VoicePacketCortex.close_session() first creates VoiceOutcome from caller-supplied result_ref/result_sha256 and only afterwards replaces each commit-eligible output with voiceoutcome_ref=outcome.outcome_id. Therefore the same logical heard output has a different packet SHA before and after SESSION_CLOSE.

VoiceOutcome.outcome_id hashes an identity payload that includes result_ref/result_sha256. The outcome remains identity/provenance-only and does not prove that result bytes equal fully heard output content.

counterhypotheses.statement: If the heard-result digest is defined from post-close VoiceOutputPacket SHA256 values, those hashes already contain voiceoutcome_ref, while voiceoutcome_ref identifies an outcome whose identity includes the heard-result digest. A naive implementation can create a circular construction or silently choose a pre-close/post-close hash convention that rebinds on replay.
counterhypotheses.required_fence: Define heard-result canonicalization independently of voiceoutcome_ref. Preserve both explicit PRE_CLOSE_CONTENT_IDENTITY and POST_CLOSE_PACKET_IDENTITY when packet hashes are receipted, and require replay to reproduce the same declared phase. Do not recursively derive heard-result payload SHA from a packet SHA that includes the resulting VoiceOutcome id.

counterhypotheses.statement: Plain text concatenation can map distinct ordered segments to the same aggregate, for example ["ab","c"] and ["a","bc"].
counterhypotheses.required_fence: Canonicalize a versioned structured sequence with explicit segment boundaries and exact order, not unframed concatenation. The canonical payload must include enough stable identity to reject omission, duplication, reordering and boundary ambiguity.

counterhypotheses.statement: VoicePacketCortex.outputs is globally sorted by (turn_id, sequence, packet_id). An integration consumer that aggregates all commit-eligible outputs without an explicit outcome/turn selection rule can accidentally include fully heard output from another turn in the same session.
counterhypotheses.required_fence: The adapter must bind an explicit ordered selected-output set to the exact VoiceOutcome causal turn/session and reject extra commit-eligible packets not admitted by that selection rule.

counterhypotheses.statement: Checking only result_sha256 is insufficient when result_ref can name a different payload identity carrying identical or stale bytes.
counterhypotheses.required_fence: Require VoiceOutcome.result_ref AND result_sha256 to equal the exact heard-result payload identity pair consumed by the adapter; neither field alone can promote state/memory/context authority.

counterhypotheses.statement: A ContextView selected item contains a cost-witness digest and copied measurement metadata, but an adapter that only compares the selected payload digest without revalidating the supplied ContextCostWitness can accept a stale or wrong-payload witness.
counterhypotheses.required_fence: For selected heard-result or interrupted-prefix context, bind the concrete supplied ContextCostWitness to the exact payload SHA256 and measured cost used by ContextCompiler; wrong payload, renderer/tokenizer identity, generation or measurement reference must fail closed.

candidate_discriminators.setup: Create one fully heard commit-eligible output, capture its SHA before close, close with the exact heard-result pair, then capture the final output SHA after voiceoutcome_ref is attached.
candidate_discriminators.expect: pre-close SHA != post-close SHA is treated as expected source behavior; adapter canonicalization remains stable and explicitly declares which packet identity phase is receipted; replay cannot substitute the other phase.

candidate_discriminators.setup: Compare two ordered fully heard sequences whose raw concatenated text is identical: ["ab","c"] versus ["a","bc"].
candidate_discriminators.expect: heard-result canonical payload SHA256 values differ; no ambiguous unframed concatenation is admitted.

candidate_discriminators.setup: Same session contains fully heard output from two turns; candidate VoiceOutcome/result selection names only one causal turn while adapter input also includes the other turn's commit-eligible packet.
candidate_discriminators.expect: adapter rejects cross-turn inclusion unless the explicit canonicalization contract deliberately and exactly binds both turns.

candidate_discriminators.setup: Exact heard-result digest is supplied but VoiceOutcome.result_ref points at a different otherwise-valid payload reference.
Interrupted heard-prefix payload has a valid digest, but supplied ContextCostWitness binds the unheard/full-output payload digest or a stale prefix generation.
candidate_discriminators.expect: fail closed before ContextView promotion; no durable memory/outcome/effect authority.
